title: The lobby tells declining from blocking: a declined guest may ask again after a minute, a blocked one may not until unblocked
why: With A02 a declined guest could never ask again, and nobody inside could see or let them in: one mistaken click shut a person out for good. Luis asked for two decisions, declining for now and blocking for good.

A declined guest may knock again once a minute has passed (migration 0011), and editors can still let them in meanwhile. A blocked guest cannot knock again from that identity until someone unblocks them; unblocking returns the entry to 'left', so the next knock waits like a first one.
LobbyEntry gains decidedAt (so the guest's page can count down to asking again, and members can see recent decisions) and knocks (so the room can tell a first knock from someone who keeps asking).

patch.value: An editor or admin lets a guest in, declines them for now, blocks them for good, or unblocks them; declining or blocking a guest in the call takes them out of it.
